summary.value: EvoMneme is portable instructions for an AI agent and a local SQLite graph of code, architecture, findings and decisions. The agent reads source code meaningfully and maintains knowledge; the SQL executor executes queries, while the CLI and viewer provide navigation. There is no built-in automatic code analyzer. This database was created at the user's explicit direction solely to demonstrate the current working tree; ongoing EvoMneme self-use and skill autoloading are not configured.
